hooks.command: if [ -f "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/.factory/config.json" ]; then dotnet run "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/hooks.cs" -- lock-specs; fi
if [ -f "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/.factory/config.json" ]; then dotnet run "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/hooks.cs" -- no-raw-commit; fi
if [ -f "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/.factory/config.json" ]; then dotnet run "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/hooks.cs" -- format; fi
if [ -f "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/.factory/config.json" ]; then dotnet run "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/hooks.cs" -- stop; fi
